Wrote and verified. All cited lines re-checked against the pinned tree (xray.go:117/506-549, controller/xray_setting.go:48/131, api.go:88, service/server.go:1198/1323, xray/process.go:79-99/486-517, config.json:20-25).

- Output: `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener/18167.json`
- Trust decision: the panel must confine Xray's `log.access`/`log.error` destinations to `config.GetLogFolder()`, decided at config generation in `resolveXrayLogPaths` (`internal/web/service/xray.go:506-549`), never at template save.
- `pattern_fit`: `injection_only` — one 3-line hunk in one function covers both named vectors; no real O2 site and no O8 route (the outbound-test config already hardcodes a safe log block).
- Strongest lever: the DB-import entry point (`internal/web/service/server.go:1198`, restart at :1323) bypasses `SaveXraySetting`/`CheckXrayConfig`, so a save-time fix leaves the advisory's own first vector open — reinforced by the in-tree comment declaring absolute/nested paths a "deliberate user choice" (`xray.go:524-537`).
- Biggest red flag: `single_site` (plus the old partial defence that was bypassable; over-broad fixes break the shipped `access:"none"`/`error:""` default).
